method: Controlled scenario observation of the prototype REST API
limitations: In-process API observation; no browser, Nginx, PostgreSQL or actual GigaChat calls.
A single controlled technical account; no interviews or observation of real people.
No load test, acceptance claim, production deployment result or human task timing.
SQLite schema was created through ORM metadata; Alembic migrations were not exercised.
